text: The Mechanism: Excess Glutamate over-activates NMDA receptors, the doors on brain cells that glutamate unlocks, acting like a key stuck in the "On" position, so too much calcium pours into the cells. In extreme cases, like a stroke or a brain injury, that calcium overload kills them, which is what "excitotoxicity" means (Sattler & Tymianski, 2001). The anxiety, rage or "itchy brain" you feel in a glutamate storm is more likely the over-excitement itself than a sign your neurons are dying.
reader: someone with trauma armor who is about to take NAC, zinc, magnesium, L-serine or D-serine to calm a glutamate storm and to make therapy sessions stick, and wants to know what each one actually does
